# Ancient + Brave

}}
Ancient + Brave is a British dietary supplement company founded in 2018 by Kate Prince and headquartered in Lewes, East Sussex, England.
The company produces collagen and botanical-based supplements and sells products in the United Kingdom and internationally.
History
Ancient + Brave was established in 2018 by Kate Prince, who previously worked in television production before founding the company.
In the early 2020s the company expanded its distribution internationally, including entry into the United States market.
Growth and coverage
Ancient + Brave was included in The Sunday Times 100, a ranking of Britain’s fastest-growing private companies.
The company has also appeared in the Financial Times annual ranking of Europe’s fastest-growing companies.
Founder Kate Prince has been featured in reporting by The Times and ITV News in coverage relating to entrepreneurship and business growth.
